description: The bar charts compare the inference time-cost of different models and methods on the MATH dataset. The x-axis represents the inference time in minutes, ranging from 0 to 2.5 minutes. The y-axis lists the models and methods: Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SF I, DPO, and O1-Pruner. The Baseline model has the shortest inference time, slightly over 1 minute for Marco-o1-7B and 4 minutes for QwQ-32B-Preview. The Fast-Solving Prompt and SF I models have similar inference times, with the Fast-Solving Prompt being slightly faster. The DPO model has a longer inference time, while the O1-Pruner model has the longest inference time. The charts show that the Baseline model is the most efficient in terms of inference time, while the O1-Pruner model is the least efficient.
